name: Linguistic Benchmarks of Online News Article Quality
description: A suite of linguistic evaluation tasks that measure the quality and characteristics of online news articles (e.g., readability, reliability, bias, or overall quality) using linguistic features.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 for classification tasks; Pearson/Spearman correlation for regression/scoring tasks
reputation: Academic/experimental suite used in NLP and media-analysis research but not a single standardized, widely adopted leaderboard.
notes: Contains multiple heterogeneous subtasks with subjective labels (bias, reliability) and risk of annotation variability; possible contamination if models were trained on news corpora used in the dataset; not a single unified LLM benchmark.
